name: Quiet ledger
description: Flat rows with thin rules and a faint zebra: dense, calm, reads like a ledger. A named grid look (instance-look@1): Change grid look… on any grid copies it into that grid's own look; Reset to skin drops it. Option 1 of 3 for build own-look-per-grid-and-tab-group (UI Review choices).
